clues.text: A messenger told Daniel the prince of this kingdom opposed him twenty-one days, until Michael came to help.
Nebuchadnezzar's captives served him and his sons in Babylon until this kingdom came to power.
In Daniel's vision, the two-horned ram stood for the kings of Media and this land.
At Susa, Vashti's banishment was written into the laws of Media and this land, so it could never be repealed.
Ezekiel said men of this land, along with Lydia and Put, served as warriors in the army of Tyre.
The Jerusalem temple was finished under decrees of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, all kings of this land.
Daniel was told three more kings would arise here, then a richer fourth who would stir everyone against Greece.
